Customer notifications

Send a notification to the shoppers who follow, like or have opted in to offers from your store. It's completely free. Mwakete keeps everyone's choices and limits in place, so a message only reaches people who agreed to hear from you. New arrivals, price drops and back-in-stock go out automatically — this page is for your own announcements and promotions.
